ctaHeading: Need a plumber in Brunswick now? Call us 24/7.
aboutText: Select Plumbing and Gas is a Melbourne-based professional plumbing company based in Brunswick, not a franchise. All our technicians are fully licensed, fully insured, and fully certified, completing every job to Australian standards. We value good communication and clear explanations, aiming for long-term customer satisfaction rather than quick fixes. With fast emergency response times across inner Melbourne, eastern, northern, western, and bayside suburbs, we are the local team Brunswick residents trust for reliable plumbing solutions.
servicesText: From urgent after-hours emergencies to scheduled maintenance and water filter installations, Select Plumbing and Gas delivers reliable plumbing solutions across Brunswick and all Melbourne suburbs with clear communication and upfront pricing.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Melbourne
services.desc: Available 24/7 for urgent plumbing emergencies across Melbourne including burst pipes, gas issues, and flooding. Fast response when you need it most.

services.title: Water Filter Installation
services.desc: Professional whole house water filter installations with clear pricing. Improve your water quality with expertly installed filtration systems for your home.

services.title: Blocked Drains Melbourne
services.desc: CCTV inspection and expert clearing of blocked drains caused by tree roots, debris, or overflow. Thorough diagnosis and long-lasting solutions every time.

services.title: Hot Water Repairs Melbourne
services.desc: Expert diagnosis and repair of hot water system failures including no hot water, inconsistent temperature, and all system types. Restoring comfort fast.

services.title: Gas Plumbing Melbourne
services.desc: Licensed gas plumbing including gas fitting, leak detection, and gas appliance installation. All work carried out to strict Australian safety standards.

services.title: General Plumbing & Maintenance
services.desc: Routine plumbing inspections, leak repairs, faucet and toilet replacements, and preventative maintenance. Keeping your plumbing system in top condition.
